newsitem.title: USA: BPA extends AC Pacific Intertie work to Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: BPA extends AC Pacific Intertie work to Tuesday.

text.p: Maintenance work set for the AC Pacific Intertie this weekend has been extended through Tuesday, the Bonneville Power Administration, which operates the Northwest portion of the transmission line, said Thursday.
Southbound flows on the 3,200 megawatt (MW) line will be restricted to 1,000 MW on Saturday and Sunday between hours ending 0730-2400 PST.
The weekend cuts are more extensive than originally planned due to scheduling of system tests, BPA said.

In addition, maintenance Monday and Tuesday between 0800 and 1700 PST on a 500 kilovolt segment of the AC line will reduce southbound flows to 2,800 MW and northbound flows to 2,500 MW, a BPA spokeswoman said.
